blocks.en: If $X\subset Y$ then the identity operator $I:X\to Y$ is well defined. Condition \eqref{eq:continuous-embedding-norm-bound} says that the output of the operator is bounded by a constant times the norm of the input. Thus, the identity is a bounded operator.
blocks.zh: 若 $X\subset Y$, 则恒等算子 $I:X\to Y$ 有良好定义. 条件 \eqref{eq:continuous-embedding-norm-bound} 表示, 算子的输出由输入的范数乘以某个常数控制. 因而恒等算子是有界算子.
blocks.label: rem:continuous-imbedding-bounded-identity

blocks.en: The Sobolev imbedding theorem says that if $\Omega$ is nice, then for sufficiently large $k$, $H^k(\Omega)$ is imbedded in a space of bounded, continuous functions. We first consider the case $\Omega=\mathbb{R}^m$. As a preparation, we state the following lemma.
blocks.zh: Sobolev 嵌入定理表明, 若 $\Omega$ 足够好, 则对充分大的 $k$, $H^k(\Omega)$ 嵌入某个有界连续函数空间. 先考察 $\Omega=\mathbb{R}^m$ 的情形. 作为准备, 陈述以下引理.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: If $\mathcal{F}[u]\in L^1(\mathbb{R}^m)$, then $u$ is a continuous bounded function. Moreover, $\|u\|_{\infty}\leq(2\pi)^{-m/2}\|\mathcal{F}[u]\|_1$.
blocks.zh: 若 $\mathcal{F}[u]\in L^1(\mathbb{R}^m)$, 则 $u$ 为连续有界函数. 此外, $\|u\|_{\infty}\leq(2\pi)^{-m/2}\|\mathcal{F}[u]\|_1$.
blocks.label: lem:integrable-fourier-transform-continuity

blocks.en: Let $s>m/2$. Then\[H^s(\mathbb{R}^m)\hookrightarrow C_b(\mathbb{R}^m).\]That is\[H^s(\mathbb{R}^m)\subset C_b(\mathbb{R}^m)\]and there is a constant $C$ such that $\|u\|_{\infty}\leq C\|u\|_{s,2}$ for every $u\in H^s(\mathbb{R}^m)$.
blocks.zh: 设 $s>m/2$. 那么\[H^s(\mathbb{R}^m)\hookrightarrow C_b(\mathbb{R}^m).\]即\[H^s(\mathbb{R}^m)\subset C_b(\mathbb{R}^m)\]且存在常数 $C$, 使对每个 $u\in H^s(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 有 $\|u\|_{\infty}\leq C\|u\|_{s,2}$.
blocks.label: thm:sobolev-full-space-continuous-embedding

blocks.en: Assume that $k>m/2$ and that $\Omega$ has the $k$-extension property. Then\[H^k(\Omega)\hookrightarrow C_b(\overline\Omega).\]If $k>(m/2)+j$, then\[H^k(\Omega)\hookrightarrow C_b^j(\overline\Omega).\]
blocks.zh: 假设 $k>m/2$, 且 $\Omega$ 具有 $k$ 阶延拓性质. 那么\[H^k(\Omega)\hookrightarrow C_b(\overline\Omega).\]若 $k>(m/2)+j$, 则\[H^k(\Omega)\hookrightarrow C_b^j(\overline\Omega).\]
blocks.label: cor:sobolev-extension-continuity

blocks.en: In Theorem~\ref{thm:sobolev-full-space-continuous-embedding}, the bound $s>m/2$ is optimal; cf. Problem~\ref{ex:sobolev-embedding-critical-counterexample}.
blocks.zh: 在 Theorem~\ref{thm:sobolev-full-space-continuous-embedding} 中, 界 $s>m/2$ 是最优的; 参见 Problem~\ref{ex:sobolev-embedding-critical-counterexample}.

blocks.en: In Example~\ref{ex:heaviside-absolute-value-sobolev-membership} we noted that the Heaviside function $H(x)$ was not in $H^1(-1,1)$. The same argument could be used to show that no function with a jump discontinuity is in $H^1(-1,1)$. The Sobolev imbedding theorem gives a much stronger result, stating that if $s>1/2$ every function in $H^s(-1,1)$ is bounded and continuous.
blocks.zh: 在 Example~\ref{ex:heaviside-absolute-value-sobolev-membership} 中注意到, Heaviside 函数 $H(x)$ 不属于 $H^1(-1,1)$. 同样的论证可用于证明, 任何具有跳跃间断点的函数都不属于 $H^1(-1,1)$. Sobolev 嵌入定理给出强得多的结果: 若 $s>1/2$, 则 $H^s(-1,1)$ 中每个函数都有界且连续.
blocks.label: ex:sobolev-jump-discontinuity

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $B$ be the ball of radius one in $\mathbb{R}^m$. In Example~\ref{ex:radial-power-sobolev-membership} we showed that $|\bm{x}|^\alpha\in W^{k,p}(B)$ if and only if $\alpha>k-m/p$. If we set $p=2$ we note that the condition of the Sobolev imbedding theorem requiring $k>m/p$ is exactly the condition that ensures $\alpha>0$ so that our radial function would be continuous.
blocks.zh: 设 $B$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^m$ 中半径为一的球. 在 Example~\ref{ex:radial-power-sobolev-membership} 中证明了, $|\bm{x}|^\alpha\in W^{k,p}(B)$ 当且仅当 $\alpha>k-m/p$. 若令 $p=2$, 则注意到 Sobolev 嵌入定理所要求的条件 $k>m/p$, 恰好保证 $\alpha>0$, 从而这里的径向函数连续.
blocks.label: ex:sobolev-radial-power-embedding

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In $\mathbb{R}^3$ the critical ``number of derivatives'' is $s=3/2$. Functions in $H^1(\mathbb{R}^3)$ are not necessarily continuous, but all functions in $H^2(\mathbb{R}^3)$ are bounded and continuous.
blocks.zh: 在 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中, 临界 ``导数阶数'' 为 $s=3/2$. $H^1(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 中的函数未必连续, 但 $H^2(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 中的所有函数都有界且连续.
blocks.label: ex:sobolev-three-dimensional-critical-order

blocks.en: More general imbedding theorems for $W^{k,p}$ spaces can be established. In particular, it can be shown that\[W^{k,p}(\mathbb{R}^m)\hookrightarrow L^{mp/(m-kp)}(\mathbb{R}^m)\quad\text{for }kp<m,\]and\[W^{k,p}(\mathbb{R}^m)\hookrightarrow C_b(\mathbb{R}^m)\quad\text{for }kp>m,\]and that each of these imbeddings is continuous. Again this extends to more general domains $\Omega$, e.g., those which have an extension property.
blocks.zh: 可以建立 $W^{k,p}$ 空间的更一般嵌入定理. 特别地, 可以证明\[W^{k,p}(\mathbb{R}^m)\hookrightarrow L^{mp/(m-kp)}(\mathbb{R}^m)\quad\text{for }kp<m,\]以及\[W^{k,p}(\mathbb{R}^m)\hookrightarrow C_b(\mathbb{R}^m)\quad\text{for }kp>m,\]且这些嵌入中的每一个都连续. 这同样可推广到更一般的区域 $\Omega$, 例如具有延拓性质的区域.
blocks.label: rem:sobolev-general-p-embeddings
